title: Cell Culture Protocol for PDLSCs and MSCs
author: Yuejun Wang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iegcbbw
materials: MSCs were digested in a solution of 3 mg/mL collagenase type I (Worthington Biochemical Corp., Lakewood, NJ, USA) and 4 mg/mL dispase (Roche Diagnostics Corp., Indianapolis, IN, USA) for 1 h at 37°C.

MSCs were grown in a humidified, 5% CO 2 incubator at 37°C in DMEM alpha modified Eagle’s medium (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA, USA), supplemented with 15% fetal bovine serum (FBS; Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA, USA), 2 mmol/L glutamine, 100 U/mL penicillin and 100 µg/mL streptomycin (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA, USA). The culture medium was changed every 3 days. MSCs at passages 3-5 were used in subsequent experiments.

steps.title: Disinfect and wash teeth
steps.instruction: Disinfect teeth with 75% ethanol, then wash with phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS).

steps.title: Isolate PDLSCs from ligament
steps.instruction: Separate periodontal‑ligament stem cells from the middle one‑third of the root’s periodontal ligament.

steps.title: Generate single‑cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the isolated tissue through a 70‑μm cell strainer (Falcon, BD Labware, Franklin Lakes, NJ, USA) to obtain a single‑cell suspension.
